two_year.rationale: Cash 2Y marks exist (US 4.77, CA 3.23, AU 4.942, NZ 3.88) but a yield level is not a dated convergence clock, and NZ eligibility alone does not time a receive or pay.

expression_memo.rationale: After screening cash 2Y, 10Y, and 2s10s across US, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand, no dated markable dislocation remains versus staying flat.

value-guy.invalidation: A dated NZ, AU, US, or CA policy, terms-of-trade, or data clock that times residual closure, or a later freeze that supplies REER/PPP cheapness with an explicit convergence window, invalidates staying flat.
value-guy.thesis: The book is already flat, and New Zealand is eligible, so NZ cash 2s/10s at 3.88/5.11 can be screened with US 4.77/5.28, Canada 3.23/3.92, and Australia 4.942/5.344 rather than being excluded on jurisdiction. Those prints are cash levels only: a 2Y cross-market gap is not cheap merely because the currency looks cheap, and screening the cash 2Y residual first still finds no dated policy, data, or terms-of-trade clock that starts mean reversion now. No REER or PPP cheapness was supplied with an explicit convergence window, so neither NZD spot nor a NZ-US or NZ-AU 2Y expression is markable on valuation. Stay flat.

expression_memo.rationale: No incremental rates or spot risk; managing the current book only.

actions.reason: Cannot mark options; do not invent strikes or substitute unbounded linear risk.

vol-convexity.invalidation: A live listed chain with executable strikes, expiries, and premiums becomes markable, or a bounded structure can be shown on those marks to dominate flat.
vol-convexity.thesis: The book is flat and the freeze contains one vol print, VIX 15.01, with no strikes, expiries, or premiums. No bounded-risk option, spread, or risk reversal can be marked, so convexity cannot be shown to dominate spot. Stay flat; do not substitute unbounded linear spot or rates for missing optionality.
